Commentary.Commentary: 170 is the target for the Lankans to win the series. The pitch is two-paced and scoring won't be easy. But if the likes of Dickwella or Dhananjaya de Silva get going, who knows what is in store. Stay tuned.

A mixed bowling performance from Sri Lanka. They started poorly, but bounced back well in the dying stages, before failing to finish it off well. Nuwan Kulasekara proved his worth with 1/30 in 4 overs while Sandakan was brilliant once more, going at under 6 an over.

Just when it seemed like the home side would surge to a massive total, the Lankans bounced back. They got the wicket of Hendricks which enforced a collapse, as the hosts lost 4/28 in 24 balls. But then, that last over from Isuru Udana swung the momentum once again.

On a surface which looked two-paced, the Proteas started off decently after electing to bat. They went hard at the new ball and once it got older, settled into milking the bowling. Smuts departed for a quick 19 and then Hendricks and de Villiers staged a fine 71-run stand for the second wicket. It was slow, but they kept the bowlers at bay.

Wonderful batting by Mangaliso Mosehle. His cameo of 32 from just 15 balls, which included 3 biggies in the final over might well prove to be the difference in the end. 148 is the average score in T20s here at Newlands, so the Proteas have scored well above par.
Very good ball, full and outside off, played through point for only a run. 21 runs from the final over has catapulted the score to 169/5!

DROPPED! Straight through his hands! Full and outside off, Mosehle swings hard but gets a top edge. The ball goes high in the air and seems to stay over there for eternity. Bowler and extra cover leave it for each other and in the end, Kulasekara at extra cover decides to go for the catch. He is late and dives but the ball bursts through his hands. The batsmen return for the second as well.
Goes again, SIX again! Brilliant! Full and outside off, Mosehle gets underneath the ball and smashes it over deep point again!
SIX! He has got hold of that, you bet! A length ball outside off, Mosehle reaches out and carves it well over the man at deep point for a biggie!
Changes his angle, bowls it from around the stumps, on a length outside off, Mangaliso swings but misses. Went too hard.
Chandimal immediately has a long conversation with his bowler. Deep backward square leg in place, fine leg comes in.
SIX! Lovely hit! A slower ball around leg and outside leg, Mosehle backs away to the leg side, picks the change in pace and swings it over the bowler, perfectly bisecting long on and long off!
ISURU UDANA to bowl the final over. Can the Lankans restrict the Proteas to 160 or below?
Full and around off, MM swings hard but gets a thick inside edge towards short fine leg. A run taken.
A short ball on middle, swatted to deep mid-wicket for a run.

A short ball outside off, Mangaliso pulls it towards square leg. Seekkuge Prasanna comes running in from fine leg, but then the ball bounces and almost goes over him, He adjusts well to leap and stop it. Just a single.
Full and outside off, pushed back to the bowler.
FOUR! Clever shot. Full and outside off, Mosehle gets down and sweeps it behind square leg for a boundary!
Landed outside off, Mosehle looks to punch but misses.
ASELA GUNARATNE to bowl the 19th over.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Delicate glance by the batsman through the fine leg region. They pick up a single.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a run.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man for a couple.
Full on middle, droven down to long on for a single.
WAYNE PARNELL is the new man in!

OUT! Dropped, but caught in the second attempt! Massive, massive wicket. It is a different thing that South Africa were not scoring freely even with AB de Villiers out in the middle but with him gone, it is an altogether different thing as well. With him around, 180, perhaps even 200 was possible, but now, even 170 looks difficult. A full toss outside off, de Villiers looks to drive this over point but Upul Tharanga at point times his leap to perfection. Drops it initially but then pouches it in the second attempt. Fantastic knock from AB on return.
The batsman drives this through the covers. One run added to the total.
Behardien is still shaking his head in the dug out. Wonder why. Not happy with AB for that call? Or with his own running? This time the pitch had nothing to do with his wicket.
Outside off, pushed through point for one.
MANGALISO MOSEHLE walks in at number 6, replacing Behardien.

OUT! Behardien has to continue shaking his head because he will not like the decision! He is short! Around middle and off, Behardien works it through mid-wicket. He takes the single and charges back for the second. Not exactly. He is not that quick as AB de Villiers and a good throw from the fielder to the keeper has him stretching. Chandimal is confident but Behardien shakes his head in response to de Villiers asking him whether he is fine. Replays show otherwise, with Behardien falling short as Chandimal whips off the bails. Behardien continues shaking his head as he walks towards the dug out. Reminds me of Glenn McGrath. Never happy was he, when given out, or when the opposition batsman was not given out.
Run out appeal! Is Behardien gone? He shakes his head. Let's see what the third umpire feels.
Full and outside off, driven towards long off for a run.
SIX! WHOOSH! What a shot. A length ball around off, de Villiers swings this mightily over mid-wicket and clears the ropes with ease!
Landed on a good length outside off, Behardien comes down the track and lofts it down to long off for a single.
ISURU UDANA comes on to bowl again. He has two overs left.
Full and outside off, driven towards cover.
Full and outside off, pushed towards long on for a run.
It's been driven superbly through the covers for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for one.

Outside off, driven towards long off for a run. Seekkuge Prasanna gets to the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but hits de Villiers on the groin instead who loses control of his bat and slips down.
Full and outside off, driven down to long off for a single.
NUWAN KULASEKARA is back on.
Full and outside off, driven towards long off for a run.
Full and outside off, punched down to long off for a single.
FARHAAN BEHARDIEN walks in at number 5, replacing Miller.

OUT! Taken! Miller has been dismissed cheaply again. Full and around middle and off, Miller gets down and plays the sweep shot. It is aerial but does not have the distance. Lakshan Sandakan takes it calmly at the ropes near deep square leg.
Full and outside off, driven towards long off for a run.
WIDE. This one is down the leg side and the batsman leaves it alone.
9th T20I Fifty for AB!
FOUR! WHAM! A short ball around off, de Villiers gets across again and pulls this behind square leg for a boundary.
Full and outside off, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Oohhh.... sees de Villiers get across his stumps and bowls it very full on middle. De Villiers somehow takes it on the full and sweeps it through square leg for a single.
This one spins back into the left-hander, the googly, Miller looks to drive but gets a thick inside edge towards square leg. A run taken.
Full and outside off, driven straight to short extra cover.
DAVID MILLER walks in at number 4, replacing Hendricks.

OUT! Stumped! Well, a comedy of errors. It was a question of who made more mistakes and eventually, the batsman won the contest. Nothing to take away from the bowler, who slipped in a lovely wrong 'un, pitching this outside off. Hendricks looked to drive but was lazy a touch. The ball spun past the outside edge and Chandimal whipped off the bails, seeming very confident. It was referred upstairs and dear me, Chandimal actually missed it in the first attempt. He was successful in the second but even by then, Reeza's foot was outside the crease! End of a 71-run stand.
Stumping appeal referred upstairs. Chandimal reckons he has got Hendricks. Let us see...
Full and down the leg side, Hendricks looks to sweep but misses and is hit on the pads.
A length ball outside off, AB swings hard but misses.
Punches this down to long on for a run.
Full and outside off, AB whips it powerfully but straight to deep mid-wicket. The fielder is taken aback by the force even after the ball bounces. A single taken.

SIX! WHACK! That has gone into orbit! A short ball around off, de Villiers gets down and across and pull-sweeps it massively over deep backward square leg! Seemed to get more height than distance but it will be a six at this ground. Might have been caught at a bigger venue.
A full toss down the leg side, Hendricks misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads towards short fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Excellent yorker outside off, pushed back to the bowler.
Landed outside off, AB looks to play the reverse sweep but mistimes it towards point.
SIX! Clean as a whistle! Full and outside off, de Villiers comes down the track and lofts it right onto the sight screen!
Full and outside off, Reeza sweeps it through square leg for a run.
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
Full and around off, pushed towards long off for a run.
Landed on middle, de Villiers comes down the track and whips it over mid-wicket for a single.

Short and outside off, punched through the covers for a brace. Isuru Udana puts in a slow chase from long off to his left and skipper Chandimal is not happy with that. "COME ON, ISURUUUUUUUUUUU!!!" he yells.
50-run stand is up in 39 balls. Slow, but they are building a nice platform here.

SAFE. A short ball outside off, de Villiers  pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. Should have been just a single but Kusal Mendis, feeling the pressure in the deep, comes running in and takes his eyes off the ball while trying to pick up and throw. The ball goes behind and the batsmen take the third on the misfield. Nuwan Kulasekara backing up from fine leg, gets to the ball and returns a good throw to Chandimal who whips off the bails as Hendricks dives in. It is a slow one and is referred upstairs. Looks closer with every angle being shown, as the bat goes up in the air after touching the ground, due to the impact. From one angle, it seems like the bat is in the air but the handle and the top portion are touching the ground. Eventually, the benefit of doubt goes to the batsman.
RUN OUT APPEAL! Is Hendricks in trouble? Referred upstairs...
Full on middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Wide outside off, AB gets down and sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Stands back and looks to punch it through the line, does not move his feet and gets a thick inside edge as the ball comes in.
Landed outside off, de Villiers brings out his reverse paddle. Is cramped for room but manages to get it through the vacant slip cordon to third man for a couple.
ASELA GUNARATNE comes on to bowl now.
Wrong one outside off on the shorter side again, cut through covers for a single.
Short again, pulled through front of square on the leg side for a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Wrong one again, spinning away, punched off the back foot through covers for a single.
Short outside off, spinning away, de Villiers punches it to long off for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Reeza eases it to long off for a single.
More work for Sandakan as de Villiers cuts this short delivery through covers again and gets a couple for it. 13 runs off it!
Short outside off, spinning away, de Villiers stays back and punches it through covers for a brace.
FOUR! Fullish outside off, AB carves it through backward point. The fielder there gets a hand to it but still the ball goes away to the fence behind. First boundary from AB!
Short outside off spinning away, de Villiers stays back and cuts it through covers for a couple.
Wide! Wide outside off, left alone. Wide is signalled!
Tossed up outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
Googly, spinning in, AB looks to drive it but gets it off the inside edge past the leg stump for a single. Lucky there!
Wrong one wide outside off, Hendricks looks to drag it but the ball is too wide. Gets a bottom edge into the ground to short mid-wicket.
Wrong one again, sliding away, de Villiers punches it through cover-point for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Wrong one, sliding away from AB, he goes back and cuts it through point. Gets a brace for it!
Slightly fuller outside off, eased on to long off for a single.
Short delivery around off, de Villiers camps back and pulls it past the short mid-wicket for a single.
LAKSHAN SANDAKAN is brought on now!
On length and angling away, punched with the angle just in front of square on the off side for a single.
Short delivery, pulled on the leg side for a single.
Fullish outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
On a length and outside off, Reeza stays in his crease and taps it through mid on for a single.
Tossed up outside off, driven through covers for a brace.
Sliding into the pads, flicked on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Back of a length delivery outside off, cut through backward point for a boundary.
On the pads, flicked on the leg side for a single.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. They pick up a single.
FOUR! On length outside off, punched through the gap between covers and mid off for a boundary.
Length delivery outside off, punched through point to get off the mark with a single.
Full outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
ISURU UDANA is back on!
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Short again, punched to cover-point off the back foot.
Full outside off, driven to covers.
Shorter and sliding in, defended off the back foot.
AB DE VILLIERS walks in to bat!

OUT! Prasanna draws first blood! Tossed up outside off, Smuts looks to sweep it but misses and is rapped up on the pads. Prasanna and co. appeal and the umpire raises his finger immediately. Smuts once again fails to make it big.
Sliding down leg, worked on the leg side for a single.
SEEKKUGE PRASANNA is introduced!
Very full and angling in, Hendricks does well to get the bat down in time. Gets it off the inside edge onto the pads and towards covers. A single taken!

Lbw appeal turned down! Slower one, angling in, Reeza gets low and looks to pull but is early into his shot. The ball hits him on the thigh and goes to short third man. There's a huge shout for lbw but it's turned down! That looked really close!
Leg bye! Angling into the pads again, Smuts misses his flick. The ball goes off the pads to square leg. A leg bye is taken!
On a length outside off, gently defended on the off side for a single.
Angling into the pads, JJ looks to flick it but gets it off inside edge onto the pads on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Boundary to start of Kulasekara's over again! Fuller on the boots, clipped through fine leg for a boundary.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full outside off, angling away, sliced over backward point for a couple.

In the air... dropped! Full on middle and off, Smuts looks to whip it but mistimes it and the ball balloons high in the air. Thikshila from mid on, runs to his right, gets under it but fails to hold onto it. A single is taken! That should have been taken!
Angling away from Hendricks, punched through point for a single.
Short delivery, pulled into the ground in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Slower one, angling across. Smuts is surprised by the slower one first up and leaves it.
ISURU UDANA to replace de Silva!
FOUR! Full outside off, pushed through cover-point for a boundary. 12 runs off the over!
Fuller length outside off, defended to covers.
Back of a length delivery, Smuts mistimes his pull through mid-wicket for a single.
Poor fielding! Length delivery outside off, tapped through point. The backward point fielder gets across to his left to cut it out but misfields and parries it behind. A couple taken!
Edged but safe! Full wide outside off, Reeza looks to drive it but gets it off the outside edge to third man for a single.
FOUR! Full outside off, Hendricks leans into the drive beautifully and gets it in the gap through covers for a boundary. Welcome into the attack, Kulasekara!
NUWAN KULASEKARA to bowl from the other end!
Angling in, played with the angle to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Slightly fuller outside off, carved through point for a boundary. Good start for Smuts!
FOUR! Full on middle and off, chipped over the bowler's head for a boundary straight down the ground! First boundary of the match!
Length delivery outside off, tapped to covers.
On length and around off, worked to mid on for a single.
Back of a length delivery angling in, tucked off the hips through mid-wicket for a single. Runs straightaway!
REEZA HENDRICKS and JJ SMUTS to open for South Africa. THIKSHILA DE SILVA to begin the proceedings with the ball. It's cool and clear out there. Perfect weather to play cricket. Let's play...

TEAM NEWS - For South Africa, AB de Villiers makes a comeback, replacing Theunis de Bruyn. Heino Kuhn and Aaron Phangiso also miss out. Reeza Hendricks and the debutante, Dane Patterson replace them. For Sri Lanka, only one change as Upul Tharanga replace the injured Angelo Mathews. Dinesh Chandimal to captain the visitors tonight.
TOSS - South Africa WIN the toss and opt top BAT FIRST!

The Islanders on the other hand fresh from their victory over the Proteas in the 2nd T20I would be high on confidence. They finally won a match in the rainbow nation and ended their 7-match losing streak in the T20Is. However, they have received a major blow as their skipper has been ruled out of the remainder of the tour due to an injury. In his absence, the visitors' camp will hope that rest of their players step up and make a statement to seal the series.

Hello and a warm welcome to the 3rd and the final T20I between South Africa and Sri Lanka. Both the teams have won a match apiece, setting up a the final T20I as a decider for the series. The hosts after being beaten in the last match will look to take revenge tonight. The stage is perfectly set for AB de Villiers, who is making a comeback in the international arena after a long absence due to injury.
